Compute Screener

Privacy

Effective 24 October 2026. This policy covers computescreener.com, the Compute Screener apps for iPhone and Android, and the Compute Screener connector for AI apps.

The apps

The apps have no accounts, ads, tracking or analytics. They download the public price files from computescreener.com (the same files the website shows) and keep them in memory while the app is open. They do not collect, store or share any personal data, and they ask for no device permissions. The Trade and Rent buttons open an exchange's or provider's own website in your browser, where that site's privacy policy applies.

Like any website, computescreener.com receives the network address and device type of each request; it is used only to serve the files and is not combined with anything else.

The website

The website sets no cookies. It counts visits with Cloudflare Web Analytics, which does not use cookies or fingerprinting, and with its own visit log, which stores the page viewed, the referring site, the country and device type reported by the network, and a visitor code derived from a salt that changes every day, so a visitor cannot be recognised from one day to the next. Raw network addresses are not stored.

The connector

The connector at computescreener.com/mcp, for AI apps such as Claude, ChatGPT and Grok, answers with the same public price files. It needs no account.

  • What it receives: the request your AI app sends when it uses one of the connector's tools: the tool's name and its arguments, such as a GPU or company name and a number of days. It does not receive your conversation, your account or your files. Like any web request, the request also carries the network address of the AI app's server.
  • How it is used: only to answer that request. The network address is also counted in memory for 10 seconds, to stop any one address from flooding the service.
  • Storage and retention: Compute Screener keeps no record of connector requests, their arguments or their network addresses.
  • Sharing: nothing is shared or sold. To answer questions about exchange prices, the connector asks the exchanges' public market-data services for their prices; those requests contain nothing about you. Cloudflare hosts the service and processes requests to deliver and protect it, under its own privacy policy.

Your conversations are covered by your AI app's own privacy policy.

Children

The site and apps are not directed to children and collect no personal data from anyone.

Changes and contact

If this policy changes, the new version will be posted on this page with its effective date. Questions: support@computescreener.com or @RenshuBTC on X; see also Support.
